messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — metering-emitter service experiencing sustained emit delay (>6m). Paging @sre-oncall and @data-platform. Runbook link posted.

sre-oncall: acknowledged. Im jumping in to check kafka consumer lag + emitter pod status.

sre-oncall: initial triage: consumer group `metering-emitter-group` lag ~1.15M, last committed offset frozen for ~7m. Emitter logs show repeated errors: "Commit failed: OffsetOutOfRange".

data-platform: FYI we pushed a small config tweak to emitter (batch_size bump) ~35m ago — might be related.

lukas: tagging billing-eng and support — any billing symptoms showing up?

billing-eng: short answer: yes. Were seeing delayed usage ingestion and two automated overage emails went out around 15:04 UTC. The counts in those alerts look like a sudden spike then flatline.

cust-success: pulled a ticket — enterprise-acct-42 got the overage notice and then a delayed-usage followup. Customer is upset and opened a support case.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) try rolling emitter pods 2) if that doesnt move offsets, start a recovery consumer that reads from earliest into a staging table (no writes to accounting) 3) suspend billing alerts while we reconcile.

jess: strong +1 to pause billing alerts. Is there a quick toggle? @billing-eng

billing-eng: yes — flipping `billing.alerts.send=false` for prod for 30m now. Confirming... done.

sre-oncall: performing rollout restart:
```
kubectl -n metering rollout restart deployment/metering-emitter
kubectl -n metering get pods -l app=metering-emitter -w
```

sre-oncall: pods restarted but offsets remain stuck. New logs now show `KafkaFetchTimeout` then `IllegalArgumentException: Required offset 23456789 no longer available` \u2014 looks like consumer checkpoint jumped past retention.

data-platform: confirms `OffsetOutOfRange`. Most likely race during offset commits combined with the batch_size change pushed producer offsets forward; consumer ended up seeking to an invalid offset.

samir: can we just set the consumer offset to earliest and reconsume? Need to be careful about double-counting.

sre-oncall: proposed safe path: spawn a read-only recovery consumer in group `metering-emitter-recovery-2764321989` that reads from earliest for the last 6 hours, writes raw events to a staging dataset. Then run a reconciliation job to compute correction deltas. No accounting writes during recovery.

sre-oncall: launching recovery consumer (dry-run -> staging):
```
./consumers/recovery --group metering-emitter-recovery-2764321989 --topic tokens --from earliest --sink staging.tokens_2764321989
```

sre-oncall: recovery consumer is ingesting; progress: ~380k messages processed and advancing. No failures so far.

billing-eng: can we estimate impacted customers quickly? Requesting a quick variance query vs rolling 24h baseline. @data-platform

data-platform: running a quick analysis. Query snippet: 
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as live_tokens, hist.tokens as prev_tokens
FROM metering.recent_hour live
JOIN metering.history_24h hist USING (account_id)
WHERE hist.tokens > 0 AND abs(SUM(tokens) - hist.tokens)/hist.tokens > 0.1
ORDER BY abs(SUM(tokens)-hist.tokens) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

data-platform: results: 16 accounts exceed 10% variance. Top offenders: enterprise-acct-42 (+480%), research-run-7 (+210%). Pattern: abrupt spike then plateau which matches emitter stalling mid-batch.

cust-success: I've messaged enterprise-acct-42: "Were investigating ingestion anomalies; will update within 60 minutes with next steps and remedial action."

sre-oncall: ETA for recovery consumer to finish staging ~25m; reconciliation run ~15m after that. So expect reconciled counts in ~40m.

billing-eng: prepping manual credit flow for any customers flagged by reconcile. Also marking any invoices touching the window as "on hold."

jess: when we reconcile, how do we avoid double-writing into accounting?

sre-oncall: reconciliation outputs idempotent correction records into `metering.corrections` with strong id keys. Accounting pipeline will apply those corrections atomically. We wont re-ingest raw events into accounting directly.

data-platform: recovery staging complete: 1.11M messages staged. Starting reconciliation:
```
python ops/reconcile.py --staging staging.tokens_2764321989 --window-start 2026-03-15T14:45:00Z --window-end 2026-03-15T15:15:00Z --out corrections_2764321989
```

data-platform: reconciliation finished. Summary: net overcount found for the window due to a duplicate commit after an offset jump. Total correction: -1,128,432 tokens across 23 accounts. enterprise-acct-42 delta: -412,200 tokens.

billing-eng: applying corrections to accounting now, retracting previously sent overage emails and queuing manual credit for enterprise-acct-42 ($2,300). Billing alerts still suppressed.

cust-success: informed enterprise-acct-42 were issuing a credit and shared timeline. Customer acknowledged and appreciated quick update.

sre-oncall: preliminary root cause: configuration change to emitter batch_size + consumer checkpoint race during rolling upgrade produced an offset seek beyond retention, causing replays/partial reads and apparent spikes.

sre-oncall: mitigation & actions completed: recovery consumer + reconciliation + correction application; billing alerts paused; credits queued; customers notified.

data-platform: post-incident follow-ups proposed:
1) revert batch_size change and re-evaluate throughput impact.
2) add preflight check for consumer group health and offset validity before next emitter rollout.
3) alerting: add explicit `OffsetOutOfRange` spike alert and consumer lag increase trend alert.

sre-oncall: creating incident page and assigning owner for postmortem: @lukas and @data-platform to lead. Will include timeline, RCA, follow-ups, and rollback plan. Tagging billing & support for customer comms.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2764321989 | Status: mitigated; follow-up required. Postmortem owner: lukas. Link to incident doc posted.

sre-oncall: closing the real-time coordination thread. If anomalies persist, reopen or ping me directly.

cust-success: closing support loop for impacted customers; tickets marked "credit pending."

jess: great collaboration team. :clap:
